As we grow in the Christian life, the thought and the faith of the Beloved Master in His never-failing intercession becomes evermore precious, and the hope of being _Like Christ_ in His intercession gains an attractiveness before unknown. And as we see Him pray, and remember that there is none who can pray like Him, and none who can teach like Him, we feel the petition of the disciples, 'Lord, teach us to pray,' is just what we need.

arxiv-2106-09031.title: An effective field theory of the Delta-resonance
arxiv-2106-09031.creator: Juan C. Criado, Abdelhak Djouadi, Niko Koivunen, Kristjan Müürsepp, Martti Raidal, Hardi Veermäe
arxiv-2106-09031.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Juan C. Criado, Abdelhak Djouadi, Niko Koivunen, Kristjan Müürsepp, Martti Raidal, Hardi Veermäe. We present an effective field theory of the Δ \Delta -resonance as an interacting Weinberg’s ( 3 / 2 , 0 ) ⊕ ( 0 , 3 / 2 ) (3/2,0)\oplus(0,3/2) field in the multi-spinor formalism. We derive its interactions with nucleons N N , pions π \pi and photons γ \gamma , and compute the Δ \Delta -resonance cross-sections in pion-nucleon scattering and pion photo-production.

arxiv-2201-03385.title: Thermodynamically consistent entropic late-time cosmological acceleration
arxiv-2201-03385.creator: D. J. Zamora, C. Tsallis
arxiv-2201-03385.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by D. J. Zamora, C. Tsallis. Entropic-force cosmology provides, in contrast with dark energy descriptions, a concrete physical understanding of the accelerated expansion of the universe. The acceleration appears to be a consequence of the entropy associated with the information storage in the universe. Since these cosmological models are unable of explaining the different periods of acceleration and deceleration unless a correction term is considered, we study the effects of including a subdominant power-law term within a thermodynamically admissible entropic-force model.

arxiv-2403-04803.title: Enhancing Security in Federated Learning through Adaptive Consensus-Based Model Update Validation
arxiv-2403-04803.creator: Zahir Alsulaimawi
arxiv-2403-04803.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Zahir Alsulaimawi. This paper introduces an advanced approach for fortifying Federated Learning (FL) systems against label-flipping attacks. We propose a simplified consensus-based verification process integrated with an adaptive thresholding mechanism. This dynamic thresholding is designed to adjust based on the evolving landscape of model updates, offering a refined layer of anomaly detection that aligns with the real-time needs of distributed learning environments.

arxiv-2501-17989.title: Simulating Curved Lipid Membranes Using Anchored Frozen Patches
arxiv-2501-17989.creator: James F. Tallman, Antonia Statt
arxiv-2501-17989.description: Abstract Lipid bilayers often form high-curvature configurations due to self-assembly conditions or certain biological processes. However, particle-based simulations of lipid membranes are predominantly of flat lipid membranes because planar membranes are easily connected over periodic boundary conditions. To simulate a curved lipid membrane, one can simulate an entire vesicle, a cylinder, or a bicelle (disk-like bilayer aggregate).

pmc-11543883.description: The prevalence of neurological disorders (NDs) such as Alzheimer's disease (AD) is increasing globally, and the lack of effective pharmacological interventions presents a significant health risk. pmc-12505815.description: Insecticides are chemicals agents used to kill insects to increase crop growth. But they can be toxic to humans and wildlife. uslaw-usc-t42-s2076.title: 42 U.S.C. § 2076 — Guaranteed purchase prices
uslaw-usc-t42-s2076.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s2076.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 23 (Development And Control Of Atomic Energy); Subchapter V (Special Nuclear Material). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Commission shall establish guaranteed purchase prices for plutonium produced in a nuclear reactor by a person licensed under section 2134 of this title and delivered to the Commission before January 1, 1971.
